description: This Java interface defines the structure and methods for handling 'FeatureProperties' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes factory methods, property setters, and JSON serialization logic related to feature data within the model.

classes.name: FeatureProperties
classes.description: An interface representing properties associated with features, allowing creation, modification, and JSON serialization of feature data.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing an immutable FeatureProperties instance.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current FeatureProperties' data for modification.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a property value with different data types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) associated with a specific key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property using a JsonField or all fields from an iterable of JsonField objects.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a property identified by the key.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the FeatureProperties to a JsonObject, filtered by the provided schema version and field selector.
